title: Grand National Uprising IV in Sofia
organizer: Organizers identified as the Poisonous Trio in the report; broader campaign actors are not treated as one organizer.
threshold_50_evidence: Mediapool’s contemporaneous account explicitly says thousands gathered in Sofia; no exact or bounded count is inferred.

start_date.summary: Contemporary Mediapool report dates the fourth Grand National Uprising to Saturday, 3 October.

location.summary: The large central gathering was at Independence Square in Sofia; the march later moved through central Sofia.

demands.summary: Attendees sought resignation of the government and chief prosecutor.

participants.summary: The report describes thousands gathered. No precise count or bounded numeric estimate is supplied.

threshold_50.summary: “Thousands” is a clear qualitative statement well above 50; exact number remains unknown.

protester_violence.summary: The report explicitly describes this rally as peaceful.

notes: One physical October 3 rally within a protest campaign reported as having begun in July. Campaign-wide descriptions/counts are not copied to this gathering. Police presence/checkpoints are not coded as state response.

title: Ruse Danube Bridge road blockade on Grand National Uprising day
threshold_50_evidence: Physical vehicle protest/road blockade is reported, but no attendance number supports 50; do not transfer Sofia’s “thousands” to Ruse.

start_date.summary: The article dates the car-convoy roadblock to the same Saturday, 3 October.

location.summary: The report locates the blockade at the Ruse Danube Bridge approach.

demands.summary: The same article places the road action in the protest series, but does not separately state the Ruse group’s demand; a link to the Sofia demand remains inferential.

participants.summary: No Ruse participant count is reported.

threshold_50.summary: No location-specific crowd count establishes 50 participants at Ruse.

notes: Kept separate from the Sofia gathering; do not pool geographically distinct participants. The state target of this local action is not explicit enough to resolve from the article.
open_questions: Was the Ruse action independently organized and directed to domestic state policy?

title: Fifth Grand National Uprising in Sofia
location: Sofia, Triangle of Power and central route
organizer: Organizers of the fifth Grand National Uprising; exact organizational hierarchy not independently reviewed.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendee number or clear qualitative lower bound in the opened body; the 100-day campaign is not used as a crowd count.

start_date.summary: BNT dates the fifth national uprising to 16 October and reports that it began at 17:00.

location.summary: The rally began at the Triangle of Power in Sofia, then moved through central Sofia.

demands.summary: BNT lists government and chief prosecutor resignations, early elections, and voting-method demands.

participants.summary: No participant count appears in the body scope read.

threshold_50.summary: The evidence establishes a rally but does not provide a count or clear minimum of 50.

protester_violence.summary: BNT reports objects were thrown at uniformed police after an attempted entry was blocked.

notes: Distinct date-specific physical rally; relation to the July-start campaign is documented but not treated as daily continuous mobilization. Objects thrown at police are coded as protester violence; police stopping entry is not enough to infer dispersal.
open_questions: Can a contemporaneous report establish at least 50 attendees?
What was the action end date and whether it was a discrete rally or continuation?

title: Police, gendarmerie and firefighters’ wage protest in Varna
organizer: Interior Ministry employee union/action; name not established in the opened body.
participants_original: More than 150 police, gendarmes and firefighters
threshold_50_evidence: bTV explicitly reports over 150 people in the Varna streets; reported as a lower bound only.

start_date.summary: bTV reports actual protest action in Varna on the evening of 21 October; Dnes had announced this as the first demonstration.

location.summary: bTV places the actual gathering in Varna.

demands.summary: Employees sought negotiations with the Interior Ministry for up to a 30% basic-pay rise and objected to exclusion from COVID frontline pay increases.

organizer.summary: The reports attribute the salary action to Interior Ministry employees and their union; exact organizer identity is not independently verified.

participants.summary: bTV reports more than 150 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters.

threshold_50.summary: The reported count is over 150 people at the Varna gathering, exceeding 50.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is described in the read passage; it is left unknown, not coded absent.

notes: The earlier Dnes page is an announcement; bTV is the contemporaneous execution evidence. The later national salary rallies are linked as a possible same-policy campaign, but no automatic episode merger is asserted.
